_comment: Capability -> backend routing. Agents ask for a CAPABILITY ('vision', 'reasoning'), never a vendor or model name, so the brain behind a capability can be swapped without touching agent code. Local providers are listed first deliberately: the system must work on this machine with no external API and no network, and a cloud provider is an optional upgrade, never a dependency. When the purpose-trained local model for this system exists, adopting it is an edit to this file.

_provider_notes.ollama: Local. Text goes through the ollama CLI; vision goes through the HTTP API at /api/generate, which is the only path that accepts images.
_provider_notes.anthropic: Optional cloud. Skipped automatically unless its `requires` env var is set, so a missing key degrades capability rather than breaking the call.

chain.note: ~1.7GB, runs CPU-only in the RAM this host has free.
